paper_title: Tur[k]ingBench A Challenge Benchmark for Web Agents
caption: Distribution of errors in a single run of GPT4 across all tasks
model_annotation: This figure presents a pie chart illustrating the distribution of errors observed when GPT-4 was evaluated across a range of tasks. The pie chart is divided into sections representing different error categories, with each section labeled and accompanied by a percentage value indicating its proportion of the total errors. The sections, arranged clockwise starting from the top, are labeled “Correct” (31.6%), “Incorrect” (43.6%), “Syntax Error” (2.3%), “Partial” (11.3%), “Partial” (8.3%), “Unknown” (1.5%), and “Incorrect” (0%), with a final segment labeled "Bad Response." The size of each slice corresponds to the percentage value indicated, with the largest slice representing “Incorrect” occupying approximately 43.6% of the total area, while the smallest slices, “Unknown” and “Syntax Error,” each represent less than 2%. The chart is centered within a white circle, and the overall color scheme utilizes shades of red, blue, and green to differentiate the error categories.
